## Purpose

Describe the consumer problem and the observable result of this change.

## Public and compatibility surface

- [ ] I identified every affected public package specifier, Java OWLAPI registry entry, and SemVer consequence, or this change affects none.
- [ ] I did not introduce an unexported deep import, undeclared dependency, source-tree bypass, or new public module without its required Java-path registry decision.

## Engineering evidence

- [ ] Tests demonstrate the change or regression before relying on implementation claims.
- [ ] Required conformance, differential, resource, browser, package-boundary, and WebVOWL consumer gates applicable to this change pass.
- [ ] New or edited code includes the context needed to preserve non-obvious standards, provenance, security, or compatibility decisions.

## Rights and provenance

- [ ] I created this contribution or have the right to submit it under the repository’s AGPL-3.0-only inbound=outbound contribution terms.
- [ ] I recorded every copied, adapted, generated, or third-party input in the applicable provenance and material inventories.

## Documentation

- [ ] User-facing behavior, limitations, compatibility status, controlled deviations, and release notes are updated where applicable.
